environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task in a private subnet. The VPC has an S3 interface endpoint (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) with an endpoint policy that includes a condition restricting access: the policy allows s3:GetObject only when aws:PrincipalOrgID matches the organization AND the s3:prefix condition key starts with 'approved-data/' AND the request must originate from the specific task execution role ARN. Additionally, the endpoint policy has an explicit Deny for any s3:GetObject where the bucket is not in the pre-approved list (only 'prod-data-bucket-7a3f'). The task role's permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ServiceBoundary) further restricts s3:GetObject to the same single bucket with the same prefix condition. The combination means even if an attacker controls the 'bucket' parameter, the VPC endpoint will reject any S3 API call targeting a non-approved bucket before it leaves the VPC, and the permission boundary independently blocks it at IAM evaluation time.

config.network: Private subnet, no NAT gateway, no internet access
config.s3_endpoint: com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 interface endpoint with restrictive policy
config.alb: Internal ALB with listener rule: only /fetch path forwarded, /debug/* returns 403 via fixed-response action
config.memory_limit: hard limit 512MB with ECS OOM kill
